ASSET: Sweet Home 3D / Scopia "Roses bush" (roses-bush) - rose shrub with 8 open red roses
CATEGORY: vegetation -> SM_FlowerBush_Red (roses-bush_red_10k), SM_FlowerBush_Yellow (roses-bush_yellow_10k).
          0.40 x 0.45 x 0.36 m as authored -> scale ~x3 for the 1.2 m catalog bush (or scatter several).
DOWNLOADED FROM (2026-10-28, all HTTP 200, non-HTML):
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arxistence/sweethome3d-git-mirror/master/3DModels/scopia/scopia/roses-bush/roses-bush.obj  (+ roses-bush.mtl, rose_petal.jpg 256, textureLeaves.png 256 RGBA)

Modified: meshes joined, decimated from 18k to 10k triangles, rescaled to metres, converted to glTF; yellow petal texture re-coloured from the original red.
